scope: Future gameplay test specifications, not executed tests

cases.environment: Real dedicated zone server, durable service and this many active clients; not supplied by the documentation package
cases.core_path: Create one of five vocations, prepare through available NPC/base skills, complete its mixed-action loop and essential North Road milestone
cases.essential_access: No mandatory player trade, party, alternate character or simultaneous profession roster
cases.shared_state: Late join sees exact current region revision; committed progress never decreases because population changes
cases.contention: Race node generation, final project contribution, craft and vendor stock; one durable effect per allowed operation
cases.transfer: One player changes zones while remaining players stay; stale leases and duplicate tickets rejected
cases.expected: Publish measured results and failures; adjust tuning without adding essential human dependencies
